definitions.explanation: A soft, white food made by coagulating soy milk and pressing the curds into blocks.

notes:
Common types:
- ⟦{木綿|もめん}→木綿：01738_momen⟧{豆腐|どうふ} (firm tofu) - denser, holds shape well
- ⟦{絹|きぬ}→絹：01383_kinu⟧ごし{豆腐|どうふ} (silken tofu) - smoother, softer texture
- ⟦{焼|や}き→焼く：01123_yaku⟧{豆腐|どうふ} (grilled tofu) - for sukiyaki
- ⟦{揚|あ}げ→揚げる：16879_ageru⟧⟦{出|だ}し→出汁：04917_dashi⟧{豆腐|どうふ} (deep-fried tofu in broth)

Counted with ⟦{丁|ちょう}→丁：noentry⟧: ⟦{一丁|いっちょう}→一丁：noentry⟧ (one block).

Related foods: ⟦{厚揚|あつあ}げ→厚揚げ：07478_atsuage⟧ (thick fried tofu), ⟦{油揚|あぶらあ}げ→油揚げ：07477_aburaage⟧ (thin fried tofu), ⟦{高野豆腐|こうやどうふ}→高野豆腐：07948_kouyadoufu⟧ (freeze-dried tofu).
